section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses used: descriptive statistics and Pearson correlations to examine associations among BMI, age, EMWSS, self-compassion (SC), body appreciation (BAS-2), and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q), and path analyses (using AMOS) to test a mediation model with EMWSS as exogenous and SC and BAS-2 as mediators predicting eating psychopathology; BMI and age were included as controls and bootstrap (5,000 samples) bias-corrected CIs were used to assess mediation. The text references a proposed model (Figure 1), but no figure asset was provided.
